text.content:
Danger Gal's flagship Pride, on screen and off.

Kind: Detective field team (a Danger Gal Pride)
Base: Floors 11–12 of the Bridgehead, Downtown
Leadership: Tigress
Purpose: Danger Gal's hardest cases, and its cartoon

The Puma Squad has been Danger Gal's photogenic crime-fighting team for forty years, and the star of its cartoon; Puma Squad: Nine Lives premiered the week of the Arvin Accord. When the agency split in 2070, the Squad stayed with Minako Arasaka. Its suites, training sims and armory take up two floors of the Bridgehead.

The Squad, 2070

  • Tigress (Solo 8). Original Puma Squad, in her fifties. Minako's second, the only person who argues with her, and still runs the YoGanger outreach.
  • Sphynx (Solo 6). Hairless, silent, chromed to the eyebrows. A Barghest scout until she wasn't.
  • Ocelot (Netrunner 6). Ex-Voodoo Boy. Agwe let him go, which nobody else gets.
  • Manx (Tech 5). Builds the cat-ear rigs, and talks to drones more than people.
  • Bobcat (Nomad 5). An Aldecaldo cousin who drives anything and wears the ears ironically.

Minako herself was a Puma, codename Calico, at nineteen; at seven she voiced Kitten in the cartoon. Michiko's oldest Puma, Mouse, went with Michiko to the Clock Tower as her bodyguard.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05; Danger Gal Dossier
